narr: Heavy rains from slow-moving, training storms created flash flooding and debris flows.
ev: Prolonged and heavy rainfall from showers parked over the Ruby Mountains produced radar estimated rainfall accumulations of 2 to 3 inches. This caused flash flooding and an area of debris flow including mud, sand, and rock over the roadway. It was estimated some spots of debris be 2 to 4 feet deep on the roadway per photos and first-hand reports.
lsr: HEAVY RAINS CAUSED FLASH FLOODING AND VARIOUS DEBRIS FLOW SPOTS WITH SOME SPOTS AS MUCH AS 4FT DEEP. BETWEEN THOMAS CANYON CAMPGROUND AND BELOW TERRACES CAMPGROUND. FLOW COVERED THE ROAD BETWEEN THES
